news.title: SkyPlane v9: the big rebuild
news.text: SkyPlane is now a full modpack: realistic airliners (Immersive Vehicles with Immersive Flight Simulator and Golden Aerotransport), Immersive Aircraft, MTR trains and stations, a working phone and PCs, and realistic shaders and textures. Press Play and the launcher sets everything up.

news.title: Mini Singapore is being built
news.text: Changi Airport, Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios and HDB estates, linked by MRT lines above and below ground. This test version is a flat world while the city is built.
